module: Main menu bar of the World Editor: File, Edit, Camera, Object, View, Window, Help menus, plus the level title, current edit mode, notifications, status bar, scene metrics (GPU/CPU memory), and dialog boxes (About, safe mode, revert level to original, save/delete/reset layouts). It provides the other tools with the APIs editor.addWindowMenuItem (entry in the Window menu), editor.showNotification, editor.setStatusBar/hideStatusBar and editor.rebuildCollision.
usage:
editor.addWindowMenuItem("My tool", function() editor.showWindow("myTool") end, {groupMenuName = 'Debug'})
editor.showNotification("Saved")
notes: In addWindowMenuItem, if `info` is provided but without groupMenuName (e.g. only experimental or gameplay), the item is added to no list: it therefore does not appear in the menu (probable game bug). Without `info`, the entry is added normally.
The Window menu remembers the recently opened tools (preference ui.general.recentWindowMenuCount, 5 by default), saved in the editor state (windowMenuRecentTools).
The File menu has no "Save Level As" (commented out in the code).
The "revert to original" button only appears for an official level or one from a mod unpacked in /mods/unpacked; it deletes the level folder then reopens the level (changes are lost).
In headless mode, only the onEditorHeadlessMainMenuBar hook is emitted, with no menu bar.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on load: clears the menu lists, creates the notification queue (maxNotificationCount 100) and installs editor.addWindowMenuItem, showNotification, setStatusBar, hideStatusBar, rebuildCollision.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when the editor is activated: applies the gizmos preferences gizmos.general.drawGizmoPlane and highlightSelectedMeshes.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the dialog windows, opens the safe mode window if needed and determines whether the "revert level to original" button should be offered.

onEditorGuiMainMenu.desc: Draws the main menu bar and the dialogs every frame. Emits onEditorMainMenuBar (or onEditorHeadlessMainMenuBar in headless).

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Reacts to the preferences ui.general.sceneMetric, gizmos.visualization.visTypes and ui.general.recentWindowMenuCount.

onEditorSaveState.desc: Adds the recent tools list to the saved state (state.windowMenuRecentTools).

onEditorLoadState.desc: Restores the recent tools list from the state (non-empty strings only).

editor.desc: Functions added to the global `editor` table by this module.

addWindowMenuItem.desc: Adds an entry to the editor's Window menu. The defaultToolWindow entries (Inspector, Scene Tree...) are at the top of the menu, separated from the others; entries are sorted by text. Calls the hook onEditorToolWindowOpened(itemText, "windowMenu") on click.

info.desc: Options: groupMenuName (submenu), experimental, gameplay (visible in the reduced editor's Window menu).

defaultToolWindow.desc: true for a window open by default, placed at the top of the menu.

showNotification.desc: Adds a notification to the queue; it replaces the one from the same group if it exists.

duration.desc: Display duration in seconds (default value otherwise).

setStatusBar.desc: Sets the status bar text and an optional ImGui callback (the bar is only visible if the text is non-empty).

uiCallback.desc: Draws additional ImGui elements; use SameLine between them.

hideStatusBar.desc: Hides the status bar. Call it when the operation is finished.

rebuildCollision.desc: Rebuilds the static collision (be:reloadCollision, then clears the flag) if needed or forced, and shows a notification.

force.desc: true to rebuild even if Engine.getNeedCollisionRebuild() is false.
